claim: ADA web accessibility lawsuits cost businesses $30,000–$100,000+ to settle; total exposure including defense, remediation, and monitoring can reach $55,000–$270,000

value_specific.landmark_disclosed_2025: $5,150,000 (Fashion Nova, Alcazar v. Fashion Nova, N.D. Cal. 2025)
value_specific.total_cost_range_including_defense: $55,000–$270,000 per case (settlement + legal defense + remediation + monitoring)

sources.name: Accessible.org — ADA website compliance lawsuit settlement amounts
Medium/Kris Rivenburgh — Website accessibility lawsuit costs
NFB v. Target — $6M settlement (NFB official announcement)

context: Settlement amounts are highly variable. Most ADA web accessibility settlements are confidential — the $30k and $85k averages are derived from aggregated third-party tracking, not a single primary source. The two confirmed public settlement figures are Target ($6M, 2008) and Fashion Nova ($5.15M, 2025). Attorney fees add $3,000–$50,000 on top of settlement amounts. Remediation costs of a non-compliant website range from $5,000–$100,000 depending on complexity. The real financial risk for most SMBs is the combination of: demand letter costs + attorney fees + settlement + mandatory remediation + potential monitoring.
important_caveat: Most ADA settlements are confidential. The $30k and $85k averages are industry estimates from accessibility advocacy tracking tools, not court-published data. Present with appropriate hedging. Only two fully public disclosed settlement amounts found: Target ($6M, 2008) and Fashion Nova ($5.15M, 2025).
